digits.purpose: The timer line. Timer view: min(100cqw / line-em, 92cqh) of the digit box; preset tiles: 100cqw / 4.3 of the tile. Fixed cells measured from the device font, minus cell reserved.

step.purpose: ±step labels and step strip choices, tabular.

hint.purpose: The glass 'Hold to show controls' hint.

meta.purpose: Version label (dim grey) and debug overlay.

shadows.name: glass-rim
shadows.purpose: Rim light on every glass control, with a 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.24) stroke. No outer shadow.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Controls, hint and exit confirm in/out; also the reduced-motion replacement for the zero glide.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Glass and preset tile press feedback (tile scale 0.97, none with reduced motion).

motion.name: icon-morph
motion.purpose: Play/pause swap from scale 0.6 and ±30°; reduced motion: opacity only.

motion.name: strip-open
motion.purpose: Step strip open/close (scaleY from 0.6); reduced motion: opacity 120ms linear.

motion.name: zero-shake
motion.purpose: One decaying horizontal shake (peak ±0.09em) per live zero crossing; none with reduced motion.

motion.name: zero-glide
motion.purpose: Glide from the old centre to the new one when the minus appears or goes; 220ms fade with reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: orientation-landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Presets switch 3×4 to 4×3; timer view drops the CSS rotation.

narrative.overview:
A single line of bold white numerals on pure black, held in fixed cells so nothing ever jumps. While the timer runs there is nothing else on screen; controls are summoned, float over the black as glass, and fade away again. The system is built for one job: read the time at an angle from 2 m under stage light, on an OLED phone lying on a synth.

Pure black and system-ui are owner-pinned hard rules (PRODUCT.md), not defaults to revisit. Colour is semantic and scarce: each hue means exactly one thing. The category default (rings, progress bars, labels around a small clock) is rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Pure #000 ground, white bold tabular digits sized to the largest width that fits.
Digit cells measured from the device's own font; the minus cell reserved from the start.
One meaning per colour: bright red = overtime, amber = needs a tap, deep red = End.
Glass only on floating controls; preset tiles are plain filled tap targets.
Silent; motion is short, and every movement has a reduced-motion variant.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each hue carries one meaning. Bright red is overtime only; deep red is End only; amber is "needs a tap" only. A new state gets a new meaning only by owner decision, never by reusing a hue.

rules.name: The Pure Black Rule
rules.body: The ground is #000 on every surface, overriding any "no pure black" guidance (dark stages, OLED).

rules.name: The Fixed Cell Rule
rules.body: Every digit sits in a cell as wide as the widest digit 0–9, measured at runtime from the resolved font (weight 700, tabular-nums); colon and minus get their own measured cells. Cells are keyed from the right so seconds stay the same element when an hour or minus appears.

rules.name: The Reserved Minus Rule
rules.body: The line is sized as if the minus were already present, so the digit size never changes at zero.

rules.name: The Quiet Stage Rule
rules.body: While running, nothing renders but the digits and any status pill that reports a threat. Controls come back on long press (500 ms) and auto-hide after 5 s without touches.

rules.name: The Glass Recipe Rule
rules.body: Glass is a 10% white fill, `blur(20px) saturate(180%)`, a 1px 24% white rim and the inset rim light above. Pressed raises the fill to 20%. In Chromium the blur is replaced by a refraction filter plus `blur(4px)`; Safari keeps the frosted blur, and it must look right there. The cut switch falls back to a plain `rgb(58 58 60 / 0.88)` fill with no backdrop filter.

rules.name: The No Outer Shadow Rule
rules.body: Glass casts no outer shadow: on #000 it is invisible and only darkens the digits underneath.

dos: Do keep every ground #000 and the digits #fff bold system-ui with tabular figures.
Do size digits from measured cells with the minus reserved, and keep the control band reserved below them.
Do put glass only on controls floating over the stage, using the one recipe and its Safari blur and fallback.
Do use Phosphor icons: fill for play and pause, bold for X.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion variant (fade instead of shake, scale or glide).
Do report anything that threatens the show in an amber pill with black text.
donts: Don't use bright red for anything but overtime digits, or deep red for anything but End.
Don't add rings, progress bars or labels around the time.
Don't put glass on the preset tiles or give glass an outer drop shadow.
Don't let the digit size or position change when a digit, the hour or the minus sign changes.
Don't use SF Symbols or downloaded SF fonts.
